## Goal
Update brainstorm SKILL.md to call run-architectural-probe.sh when classify-epic-class.sh returns class:architectural, before the scrutiny gate runs.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md: after class detection (S4), when class:architectural call run-architectural-probe.sh; probe failure causes brainstorm to halt with refusal before scrutiny

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -c 'run-architectural-probe' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md should be at least 1
- bash tests/scripts/test-architectural-probe-gate.sh exits 0 (still GREEN)

## Testing Mode
GREEN (instruction file update; depends S5/T2)
